notes: Names, types and challenge ratings from the System Reference Document 5.1 by Wizards of the Coast LLC, licensed under CC-BY-4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode). Groups and descriptions are our own words. Used as the {foe} in hostile-group encounters, and the beasts as predators in the twist table. Plan 7 Track N (Claude): every creature has a combat role and a size (data/claude/enemy-roles.json), and the creatures after the first 19 were added for dungeon rooms and Crisis sites, with "roads": false so the road slots draw from the same creatures as before.

entries.name: Bandit
entries.description: Desperate road-thieves who would rather rob the weak than fight the strong.

entries.name: Bandit Captain
entries.group: a bandit captain and her crew
entries.description: A seasoned outlaw who keeps her gang in line by being the most dangerous of them.

entries.name: Thug
entries.description: Hired muscle that deals in threats and broken fingers.

entries.name: Cultist
entries.description: Zealots of a hidden god, more fervent than skilled.

entries.name: Veteran
entries.description: Old soldiers who have seen too many battles to fear one more.

entries.name: Goblin
entries.description: Small, quick and cruel, and much braver in numbers.

entries.name: Hobgoblin
entries.description: Disciplined goblinoid soldiers who fight in tight ranks.

entries.name: Bugbear
entries.description: Hulking goblinoids who prefer an ambush to a fair fight.

entries.name: Orc
entries.description: Fierce raiders who take what the land won't give them.

entries.name: Gnoll
entries.description: Hyena-headed raiders with a hunger that is never satisfied.

entries.name: Kobold
entries.description: Tiny reptilian schemers who trust traps and numbers over courage.

entries.name: Lizardfolk
entries.description: Cold-eyed marsh hunters who see everything as food, threat or tool.

entries.name: Ogre
entries.description: A brute of enormous strength and very little patience.

entries.name: Worg
entries.description: Cunning wolf-like beasts that can speak, and hold grudges.

entries.name: Ghoul
entries.description: Starving dead whose claws lock the living rigid with fear.

entries.name: Wolf
entries.description: Lean grey hunters that wear their prey down together.

entries.name: Dire Wolf
entries.description: Wolves the size of ponies, patient and terribly strong.

entries.name: Brown Bear
entries.group: a she-bear and her grown cubs
entries.description: Half a ton of hunger that doesn't care whose meal it takes.

entries.name: Giant Spider
entries.description: Web-spinners as big as a mule, with a venomous bite.

entries.name: Giant Rat
entries.description: Rats the size of dogs, grown fat and bold in the dark.

entries.name: Mastiff
entries.description: Heavy-jawed guard dogs, kept hungry on purpose.

entries.name: Giant Wolf Spider
entries.description: Dog-sized spiders that run their prey down instead of waiting in a web.

entries.name: Swarm of Insects
entries.description: A clicking, biting carpet of beetles, spiders or worse, moving as one.

entries.name: Hyena
entries.description: Cackling scavengers that dart in to bite and dart away again.

entries.name: Giant Crab
entries.description: Shield-broad crabs that pinch first and never let go.

entries.name: Crocodile
entries.description: A log that opens into a mouth full of teeth.

entries.name: Giant Crocodile
entries.description: A crocodile as long as a boat, old and patient.

entries.name: Giant Scorpion
entries.description: Armoured desert hunters with claws like vices and a killing sting.

entries.name: Giant Ape
entries.description: Apes taller than a house that hurl boulders when they cannot reach you.

entries.name: Skeleton
entries.description: Old bones made to stand and fight; they do not tire and they do not stop.

entries.name: Zombie
entries.description: Slow, stubborn corpses that keep coming after they should have fallen.

entries.name: Shadow
entries.description: Darkness that moves on its own and drinks the strength out of the living.

entries.name: Specter
entries.description: A hateful ghost whose touch withers what it passes through.

entries.name: Ghost
entries.description: A soul bound to the place it died; one look at its face can age you years.

entries.name: Wight
entries.group: a barrow-host led by a wight
entries.description: A cunning dead warrior who commands lesser corpses and drinks life with its blade.

entries.name: Mummy
entries.description: Wrapped dead whose fists carry a rotting curse.

entries.name: Vampire Spawn
entries.description: A vampire's fed-upon servant: quick, strong and always hungry.

entries.name: Animated Armor
entries.description: An empty suit of armour that marches and strikes on its maker's old orders.

entries.name: Stone Golem
entries.description: A carved guardian that cannot be bribed, frightened or tired.

entries.name: Gargoyle
entries.description: A living statue that waits on a ledge for years, then drops on its prey.

entries.name: Azer
entries.description: Bronze-skinned smiths of living fire, with beards of flame.

entries.name: Fire Elemental
entries.description: A towering shape of flame that sets alight whatever it touches.

entries.name: Salamander
entries.description: Serpent-bodied creatures of flame that crush and burn in the same embrace.

entries.name: Otyugh
entries.description: A three-legged sack of hunger that lives in filth and eats anything.

entries.name: Black Pudding
entries.description: A heaving black ooze that dissolves wood, metal and flesh alike.

entries.name: Winter Wolf
entries.description: Pale wolves the size of ponies whose breath is a killing frost.

entries.name: Phase Spider
entries.description: Spiders that blink out of the world and back, a step behind you.

entries.name: Hill Giant
entries.description: Greedy, dim and enormous, with a club made from a tree.

entries.name: Stone Giant
entries.description: Grey, quiet giants of the high places, who throw boulders with deadly aim.

entries.name: Fire Giant
entries.description: Soot-black giants of the forges, as skilled with a hammer as with a sword.

entries.name: Red Dragon Wyrmling
entries.description: A newly hatched red dragon, the size of a hound and already greedy.

entries.name: Young Red Dragon
entries.description: A red dragon not yet grown, all temper and fire.

entries.name: Scout
entries.description: Woods-wise hunters and lookouts who shoot from cover.

entries.name: Cult Fanatic
entries.description: True believers who have been given a little real power, and want more.

entries.name: Knight
entries.description: Armoured riders sworn to a lord, who fight in order and call their charges.

entries.name: Mage
entries.description: A learned spellcaster who settles arguments with fire.
